instruction: A crocheted sea otter pup floating on its back, stubby paws pressed together over a rounded belly. Chunky single-crochet spirals form the cocoa-brown body with a cream muzzle and pale peach paw pads, each stitch a distinct raised loop. A safety-eye pair, a stuffed sausage tail and a slightly lopsided head give it wobbly handmade charm.
